Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Jeff wrote:
> Someone is having success with it. That's a good sign the idea merits further exploration.
>
Is it?
The smaller the tournament, the higher the chance of winning it whatever the deck (because it's far easier to reach the final). It's one of the reason why the TWDA don't include tournaments with less than 10 players.

I'm not saying that the deck is bad, but I'd rather hear Josu say that MKAtW was a great addition and explain the context rather than conclude that it is good because it has won a 9-players tournament.

(An extreme example would be someone playing plenty of copies of a clanhoser and winning a tournament because his prey plays that clan. Is the clanhoser a good card because someone won one tournament with it?)

Anyway, I've given my opinion based on my numerous attempts to use that card in the exact same kind of deck.

Prince of Paris, France
